title: Why ultralearning matters
coreMove: Decide when a hard skill deserves protected intensity instead of being left as casual exploration.
sourcePressure: The chapter contrasts ultralearning with dabbling and frames rapid adaptation, focused effort, and weakness-first work as a response to changing conditions. The source sidecar contains no named people, studies, institutions, places, dates, or artifacts for this chapter, so named source anchors must be omitted rather than invented.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Saying every interest should become a high-pressure project or that intensity alone beats thoughtful exploration.

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person You direct address, retrospective It took her three weeks to see, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

exampleSpecs.domain: Emily, a payroll coordinator reskilling before automation changes her role
exampleSpecs.audience: a learner who has been mistaking motion for progress
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether the next month produces visible evidence or another private feeling of effort
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Emily marks payroll automation as a project, not an interest, by blocking two protected evenings and naming the reconciliation report she must produce.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: a payroll exception report with two red cells under a fluorescent office light

exampleSpecs.domain: Thomas, a paramedic learning ultrasound for rural transfers
exampleSpecs.audience: a practitioner under a near-term performance constraint
exampleSpecs.stakes: whether a deadline exposes the weakness early enough to adjust
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Thomas decides rural ultrasound deserves intensity because the next transfer shift will ask for the skill before he feels ready.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: an ambulance bay training probe coiled beside a clipboard
